invariants.rationale: The method always returns an iterator, produced by Collections.singletonList(...).iterator(), which is never null.
Since the method returns an iterator of a singleton list, hasNext() will always be true when the iterator is created.
The singleton list contains a non-null WriteStatus list returned by createHandle.close(), so if hasNext() is true, next() is not null.
Even if the recordMap is empty, the method creates a WriteStatus list and returns it wrapped in an iterator, which will always have next.
